fieldMarks: Male: black head and chest with white face patch and belly spots, reddish collar, brown back
Female: mottled brown with a hint of reddish collar
behavior: Loud creaking call during breeding season
Scares easily and hides, preferring to run rather than flush (Hawaii)
habitat: Thick vegetation, brushy areas and tall grassland, generally near water; mosaic of forest and cultivated land, not interior forest.
range: Native to India; introduced to Hawaii in 1959. NatureServe records it in Florida.
